title: DYNAMIC Pilot Optimization Trial
official: DYNAMIC: Development of a Behavioral Intervention for Young Adults With Advanced Cancer
summary: The purpose of this pilot optimization trial is to evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of using an optimization approach to refine DYNAMIC, a behavioral intervention designed to improve psychosocial well-being among young adults ages 25-39 with advanced cancer. This study is guided by the Multiphase Optimization Strategy (MOST) framework. Participants will be randomized using a 2x2x2 factorial design to receive up to three DYNAMIC intervention components: relaxation training (yes/no), cognitive behavioral therapy-based skills training (yes/no), and young-adult relevant health education (yes/no).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 25 to 39 years.
* Diagnosed with or progressed to stage III or IV advanced cancer between ages 25 and 39.
* Able to speak and read English.
* Life expectancy of at least 6 months.
* Able to provide informed consent.
* Willing to be randomized to a study condition.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed or observed psychiatric or neurologic disorder that could interfere with participation (e.g., active psychosis).
* Inability to provide informed consent.
